_meta.description: UK-specific series catalogue for the UK Macro Heatmap. Single source of truth for UK series identity, source, and ingestion metadata. 48 series covering Growth, Inflation, Employment, Wages, and Housing (assigned to Growth factor). Mirrors the schema of series_catalogue_ea.json.

field_reference.id: Unique machine-readable slug. Used to cross-reference series across tools and config files.
field_reference.name: Human-readable short label.
field_reference.description: What the series measures and why it matters.
field_reference.source: Data vendor: bloomberg | haver | ecb | eurostat | derived.
field_reference.ticker_bloomberg: Bloomberg ticker string (e.g. 'PMITUKG Index'). null if not available on Bloomberg.
field_reference.ticker_haver: Haver mnemonic (e.g. 'PMIUKCO@EMERGE'). null if not available on Haver.
field_reference.units: Unit/scale of the raw series as pulled from source.
field_reference.typical_lag_days: Calendar days from reference period end to typical publication date. null for daily market data (no publication lag).
field_reference.asset_class: Grouping: macro_survey | macro_activity | macro_inflation | macro_labour | government_bonds | rates_swaps | inflation_swaps | commodities | volatility.
field_reference.geography: Primary geographic scope of the series.
field_reference.tools: List of tool IDs in the hub that consume this series.
field_reference.role: How the series is used: factor_input (DFM macro block) | target (y-variable in regression model) | predictor (x-variable) | market_data (general market series).
field_reference.dfm_factor: For factor_input series: which DFM factor this series primarily identifies (Growth | Inflation | Employment | Wages). Housing series are assigned Growth.
field_reference.dfm_sign: For factor_input series: +1 if series moves in the same direction as the factor, -1 if inverse (e.g. unemployment rate is -1 for Employment factor).
field_reference.dfm_col_index: Zero-based column index in the DFM observation matrix Y_daily. Must be contiguous 0-47.
field_reference.dfm_primary: True for exactly one series per factor group — the sign-anchor series used for PCA orientation.
field_reference.heatmap_group: Display grouping label used in the UK heatmap UI.
field_reference.notes: Free-text caveats, data quirks, or ingestion instructions.

series.name: UK Composite PMI
series.description: S&P Global/CIPS UK Composite PMI Output Index. Covers manufacturing and services. Above 50 = expansion. Flash estimate is the market-moving release.
series.notes: Use flash release date as ingestion date (~3 weeks after month-end). Final release follows ~1 week later but adds little information. ticker_haver could not be confirmed against the real Haver UK database in this pass - needs manual lookup via Haver metadata search before enabling ANALYTICS_DATA_SOURCE=haver for this series.
